name: DodoDirectory
conditions: Free Listing requires a backlink to dododirectory.com; the badge must stay on your site permanently — 'removal = instant delisting'.
Free queue: reviewed and listed within 2 weeks; ~3,000-character listing; no AI-written SEO description; no support.
requirements: Any website/business — a general business directory (359+ listed; categories from SaaS/AI to Local Business).
Content restrictions at checkout: no crypto, adult, gambling, or illegal content (processed by Polar).
Every plan includes a permanent dofollow backlink and a dedicated review page.
preparation: Badge/backlink to dododirectory.com placed permanently for the free tier.

Plan choice: Free $0 / Premium $9.99 one-time (instant approval, 3 dofollow, AI-written ~6000-char listing) / Review Article $49.99 (10k-char AI review blog post) / Press Coverage $299 (third-party CoveragePush).
workflow: Pick Free or a paid tier on /pricing.
Free: install the badge, submit, wait up to 2 weeks.
Premium: instant approval and listing — skips the 14-day wait.
watchFor: Harshest badge enforcement seen: permanent badge required, 'removal = instant delisting' for free listings.
Free listings explicitly get no AI-written description — your ~3000-char copy is all you get.
'AI-powered review' language means listing copy may be machine-generated on paid tiers.
The $299 press-coverage block is a third-party service (CoveragePush) embedded as an upsell — not needed for the listing.
Prohibited-content list comes from the payment processor (Polar) — crypto/adult/gambling rejected.
countsAsLive: A dedicated listing/review page at dododirectory.com/item/<slug> linked from category pages.
unknowns: Whether account registration is required to submit.
How 'instant approval' interacts with content moderation on paid tiers.
